description: Legal Affairs Department - Inland Trust Receipts (Amendment) Act. No.22 of 2024.
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the commencement date of the Inland Trust Receipts (Amendment) Act, No. 22 of 2024. It is a legal/regulatory matter concerning the implementation of an amended law, falling squarely under Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters. While it names an individual (the Minister) who issued the order, the primary content is about bringing a law into operation, not about government personnel changes or detailed portfolio responsibilities.
